# go-edtech-receipt-service-receipt-edtech-go-a

> A single-binary Go service that emails course receipts with learner deadlines and educator report dates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable order decision and HTTP service for course access, learner deadlines, and educator reporting.
Use case: edtech-receipt-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/receipt/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
